author: TeIq
content: Implemented + tested. The WebSocket run-loop is now wired up: park_consumer is gone, UpstreamLabelerConsumer::run drives proto-blue's WebSocketKeepAlive against wss://{hostname}/xrpc/com.atproto.label.subscribeLabels?cursor={seq}. Each binary envelope is decoded via Frame::decode, dispatched by #labels/#info tag, and per-label handle_frame_with_seq calls feed indexed_labels (#180) and observations. Cursor advances per-envelope with seq-monotonic guard. CancellationToken integration for clean shutdown. 12 unit tests (including 3 new url-builder tests covering seq=0/positive/scheme-normalize), 5 integration tests pass. Clippy clean -D warnings.
